items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: We talked about that when he was through here about four years ago, and he remembered me

ctx.x: Yeah, they were making "Wings". That's where they made it. After they got through it, the set each day, they would come to the Gunner Roof and they had a table reserved over by me and I used to like that.
We talked about that when he was through here about four years ago, and he remembered me, he said you're that little guy who was playing
that trombone down in San Antonio.
